description: A polygonal temple in a temenos north of the east gate, outside the walls. The date is uncertain but must be after when the city walls were built (c. 75).
bibliography: Hudd, Alfred E. “Excavations at Caerwent, Monmouthshire, on the Site of the Romano-British City of Venta Silurum, in the Years 1911 and 1912.” Archaeologia 64 (1913): 447 ff.
